title: API: supplyFilter under-, well- or over-supplied never returns an untracked part
custom_preconds: Env https://sv10647.qa.shopview.com (S2 shop), location "Staging Heavy Duty". API calls are replayed from Chrome DevTools (Network tab: copy the request the screen sent, edit, resend) against sv10647api.qa.shopview.com with header X-Location-ID = the current location. Logged in as (a) Admin or a default Parts Manager. Setup as (a): New Inventory Part "QA-S6-SUP-{run}" (description "QA S6 supply"), tracked, default bin quantity 1, Min 5, Max 10, Save.
custom_steps:
1. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&search=QA-S6-SUP&supplyFilter=under-supplied.
  2. Open QA-S6-SUP-{run}, switch "Track quantities and cost of goods" off and Save; resend the step 1 call.
  3. Send GET /api/inventory/parts?status=active&supplyFilter=under-supplied (no search) and load every page.
  4. On /parts/inventory pick Supply → Well-supplied, then Supply → Over-supplied, and read each GET /api/inventory/parts response (supplyFilter as the screen sends it), loading every page.
  5. Pick Supply → All and read the response; then send the call with no supplyFilter.
custom_expected:
1. 200 with QA-S6-SUP-{run}, is_tracked true (below its Min).
  2. 200 with no rows: the part is now untracked and left out even though it is below its Min.
  3. 200; every row has is_tracked true; no untracked part (QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2, QA-S6-SUP-{run}) appears.
  4. 200 each time; every row has is_tracked true.
  5. Both responses include the untracked parts (QAPL-U1, QAPL-U2, QA-S6-SUP-{run}).
